WITH invoice_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    i.InvoiceId,
    c.Country,
    AVG(il.UnitPrice) as invoice_avg_price
  FROM Invoice i
  JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
  GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(invoice_avg_price) as overall_avg
  FROM invoice_avgs
),
invoice_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    ia.InvoiceId,
    ia.Country,
    ia.invoice_avg_price,
    ia.invoice_avg_price - oa.overall_avg as deviation
  FROM invoice_avgs ia
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
),
country_avg_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    Country,
    AVG(deviation) as country_avg_deviation
  FROM invoice_deviations
  GROUP BY Country
),
final_values AS (
  SELECT 
    id.InvoiceId,
    id.Country,
    id.invoice_avg_price,
    id.deviation,
    id.deviation - COALESCE(cad.country_avg_deviation, 0) as final_deviation
  FROM invoice_deviations id
  LEFT JOIN country_avg_deviations cad ON id.Country = cad.Country
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN final_deviation IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, final_deviation DESC) as dense_rn
  FROM final_values
)
SELECT InvoiceId, Country, invoice_avg_price, deviation, final_deviation
FROM ranked
WHERE dense_rn <= 10
ORDER BY CASE WHEN final_deviation IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, final_deviation DESC
